summary: The exact locked candidate preserves the canonical composition, plan projection, water and road topology, capital and port footprints, full-bleed edges, and clean hybrid seams. It nevertheless fails strict Vision QA because three immediate-failure patterns are plainly visible: dense repeated forest loop/crown wallpaper, recurring bundled highland slashes, and rigid parcel-wide field rows and hatch bands. The score is 80/100, below the 94/100 threshold; the decision is rejected regardless of the otherwise strong geometry and network.
required_changes: Replace the northwestern forest carpet with sparser non-symbolic print material: eliminate repeated same-scale U, loop, and crown stamps; introduce larger calm gaps, varied density, and genuinely non-recurring local marks while preserving the exact forest footprint, coast, and river.

Rebuild the northeast highland surface so hatches are isolated single marks or occasional non-repeating pairs with varied length, angle, spacing, and placement; remove every recurring four-to-seven-stroke bundle and preserve the broad planar tone and canonical geometry.

Rebuild all eight field interiors with independent broken marks, nonperiodic drift, irregular gaps, and parcel-to-parcel variation; remove aligned dot ranks, repeated row spacing, continuous parallel bands, and any CAD-grid cadence while preserving parcel outlines and crossing roads.

Reduce the capital's residual central-hub emphasis by offsetting or interrupting broad arterial convergence while retaining one exact outer wall, five exact gate junctions, irregular shared-boundary blocks, varied tiny footprints, and the canonical external road topology.
Submit the revised exact raster through the same 25, 50, native, 200, 400, nine-region, motif, and seam review; it must clear all immediate failures and score at least 94 before promotion.
